notes: Sampled January 1911 Saturday Real Estate building contracts sections as feasibility assessment. Located 37 pages across 4 Saturdays with BUILDING CONTRACTS header. Format confirmed: 'Owner with Contractor—Description; $Amount'. OCR quality is moderate to heavy corruption in owner/contractor names but street numbers mostly readable and metes-and-bounds notation preserved. Two sample entries extracted and documented. Extraction strategy mapped: high-confidence entries are street numbers (~30-40% of total); remaining entries require corner.py tool. Estimated 80-120 entries for January, extrapolated to 800-1200 for full year. Data structure ready for parser implementation in next session.

coverage.remaining: Sampling complete for January only; full year (1911) awaiting parser implementation. 1912-1913 blocked by Cloudflare access issues on bulk OCR endpoint.
